content: विहारः .²1 Removing, taking away. .²2 Roaming or walking for pleasure, airing, a stroll, taking a walk. .²3 Sport, play, pastime, recreation, diversion, pleasure; विहारशैलानुगतेव नागैः <ls>R. 16. 26</ls>, <ls n="R. 16.">67</ls>, <ls n="R.">5. 41</ls>, <ls n="R.">9. 68</ls>, <ls n="R.">13. 38</ls>, <ls n="R.">19. 37</ls>. .²4 Tread, stepping, movement (of hands, feet <ab>&c.</ab>); विकर्षणैः पाणिविहारहारिभिः <ls>Ki. 4. 15</ls>; दरमन्थरचरणविहारम् <ls>Gīt. 11</ls>. .²5 A park, garden; especially a pleasure-garden; आरामैश्च विहारैश्च शोभमानं समन्ततः <ls>Rām. 7. 70. 13</ls>. .²6 The shoulder. .²7 A Jaina or Buddhist temple, convent, monastery. .²8 A temple in general. .²9 Great expansion of the organs of speech. .²10 Opening, expansion. .²11 The palace or banner of Indra. .²12 A palace in general. .²13 A kind of bird. .²14 (Mīmāṃsā) The triad of fires, <ab>viz.</ab> गार्हपत्य, आहवनीय and दक्षिण; विहारे लौकिकानामर्थ साधयेत् <ab>etc.</ab> <ls>MS. 12. 2. 1</ls>; (विहार इति गार्हपत्यादिरग्नित्रेता उच्यते विहरणात् <ls>ŚB. on MS. 12. 2. 1.</ls>). .²15 <ab>N.</ab> of the country मगध (modern Bihar). .²16 The sacrificerʼs house (यजमानगृह); <ls>Bhāg. 4. 5. 14</ls>.
